content: Ola biginini blanga Edam
Wal iya na ola neim blanga ola biginini blanga Edam. Wen God bin meigim pipul, imbin meigim olabat laik imselp.
Imbin meigim boiwan en gelwan, en imbin brabli gudbinji blanga dubala, en det seim dei weya imbin meigim dubala, imbin gulum dubala men en wuman.
Bambai na wen Edam bin olmen 130 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim Seth, en det lilboi bin jis laik im dedi.
Wal Edam bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin brabli olmen,
en imbin dai wen imbin 930 yiya ol.
Wal Seth bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 105 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim Inash,
en Seth bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin brabli olmen,
en imbin dai wen imbin 912 yiya ol.
Wal Inash bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 90 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim Kenan,
en Inash bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin brabli olmen,
en imbin dai wen imbin 905 yiya ol.
Wal Kenan bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 70 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim Mahalalel,
en Kenan bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin brabli olmen,
en imbin dai wen imbin 910 yiya ol.
Wal Mahalalel bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 65 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim Jered,
en Mahalalel bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin brabli olmen,
en imbin dai wen imbin 895 yiya ol.
Wal Jered bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 162 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim Inak,
en Jered bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin brabli olmen,
en imbin dai wen imbin 962 yiya ol.
Wal Inak bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 65 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim Mathusala,
en Inak bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin olmen. Wal Inak bin bilib langa God brabliwei,
en wen imbin 365 yiya ol, God bin deigim im laibala langa top garram im, dumaji Inak bin oldei bulurrum God brabliwei.
Wal Mathusala bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 187 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi neim Leimek,
en Mathusala bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin brabli olmen,
en imbin dai wen imbin 969 yiya ol.
Wal Leimek bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 182 yiya ol, imbin abum lilboi,
en Leimek bin gulum det lilboi neim Nowa, en imbin tok, “YAWEI det trubala God bin meigim dijan graun adwan. Bat main lilboi garra gibit melabat spel brom dumbat adwek.”
Wal Leimek bin kipgon abumbat biginini raidap imbin brabli olmen,
en imbin dai wen imbin 777 yiya ol.
Wal Nowa bin merrit, en wen imbin olmen 500 yiya ol, imbin abum thribala lilboi neim Shem, Hem en Jeifeth.
